source_native_System.candidate_models: Mutually competing empirical observer model interpretations, not all simultaneously established cognition in each human participant.
source_native_System.Bayes_ideal: r_t run length, ξ_t prior-state and π_t current category probability source S1 recursion S1–S24; Markov change dependence and source reset; this is prior Adams-MacKay extension, not newly discovered universal memory requirement.
source_native_System.Exp_bias: Original main Eq3 trial-based category-probability delta updating state p_hat_t with α, then source Eq4 weighted equal-prob prior w, criterion response. w parameter does not demonstrate physically separate literal biological stored knowledge.
source_native_System.Wilson_three_node: Original 2013 mixed delta-rate hazard/weight approximation, source three-node parametrization, not a new P13 brain controller.
source_native_System.RL_main_criterion: Source original main Eq7 changes decision criterion only on incorrect outcomes, source S1 EqS25 separately defined probability-updating alternate; do not collapse.
source_native_System.Behrens_comparator: Source existing 2007 pi-volatility-k probabilistic state/transition, not universal new cognitive substrate.
source_native_System.Fixed_original: Source original neutral decision criterion comparator, not sensory processing absence

World_and_Experiment.World: Five externally programmed category probabilities changing 80–120 trials and externally known source category-generating Gaussian stimulus and correct feedback; experimenter controls sample-and-hold Markov transition.
World_and_Experiment.Experiment: Original human 11 observer two task session probes 800 test trials each after 200 training; model comparison marginal likelihood/conditional BIC-ELBO and two different response noise/measurement interfaces. Pre-test explicitly explains categories but not future change distribution.
World_and_Experiment.Internal_observation_boundary: True generating C_t externally revealed after trial by explicit feedback, subjects are NOT asked to infer hidden unlabelled category; Bayesian run-length and prior probability are candidate model latent variables.
World_and_Experiment.Source_evidence: Original Fig2–5 model-output/observer data and published S1 recovery simulated model datasets; externally reported group fit scores are experimenter observation, not internal system Q or another neurocognitive tier.

unchanged_grammar_role_assignments.Pi: Five source environmental states vs candidate modeller posterior over r, ξ, pi distinct boundary; optional response categories A/B and separate covert/overt observational interfaces.
unchanged_grammar_role_assignments.X: Source candidate posterior table U(r,ξ|C history) or Exp p_hat plus optional Wilson node weights or RL criterion state; do not conflate competing variants.
unchanged_grammar_role_assignments.C: 80–120 actual runlength, true five pi values; candidate wrong-belief r/pi/beta constraints; source separate fitting protocols, reset and noise; 11 observers.
unchanged_grammar_role_assignments.Q: Source neutral 0.5 bias and model-specific criterion conditioned on inferred probability plus task reward correctness criterion, not fabricated generic value or proof emotion.
unchanged_grammar_role_assignments.P_in: Experimenter stimulus orientation, true post-trial category feedback, overt pre-stimulus task instructions; source correct-label sequence drives update.
unchanged_grammar_role_assignments.P_out: Covert category keypress or overt pre-stimulus continuous criterion setting with adjustment noise; source two different original likelihood interfaces.
unchanged_grammar_role_assignments.K: Exact original S1 Markov Bayesian previous-state posterior update; source main Eq3/4 Exp/Expbias; Wilson prior nodes; RL criterion negative-only; Behrens volatility comparator.
unchanged_grammar_role_assignments.T: Source explicit 800 trial sequence, one-trial online category feedback, hidden prior changepoints at experimental 80–120 trial scale, model inferred effective short tau4.5, not literal EEG or neuron clocks.
unchanged_grammar_role_assignments.rho/O: Observable task-specific raw choices/criterion line, reported group protected exceedance f/phi relative only main comparator, separate flexible Bayes nondiscrimination, S1 partial model recovery.

source_claim_mapping.source_native_proposition: External category-A probabilities exactly set of five {0.2,0.35,0.5,0.65,0.8}; stepwise change every 80–120 trials randomly chosen excluding previous state; no explicit new-block cue
source_claim_mapping.source_location: Main PDF p4 Fig1C/D + p18 methods

source_claim_mapping.source_native_proposition: Externally sampled Gaussian category stimulus orientation and participant sensory measurement uncertainty form source task likelihood, not participant-controlled world dynamics
Covert task subject makes trial-level binary orientation category keypress after stimulus; receives explicit true-category feedback
Overt task subject reports continuous oriented decision boundary BEFORE stimulus then sees category feedback, has separate adjustment noise
Original 11 observers (one author) complete 200 familiarization training then 800 experimental trials per original covert/overt session and independent sensory measurement session
Ideal Bayes observer posterior over possible run lengths and previous category probability state with Markov transition dependence, then marginalizes to category-A predicted prior
source_claim_mapping.source_location: Main PDF p5 Eq1, official S1 pp3–8

source_claim_mapping.source_native_proposition: Exact original Bayesian recursive posterior separates conditional category prediction, predecessor run-length and previous-state joint posterior; P13 source extends Adams-MacKay prior formalism
Change-point hazard on source 80–120 run length and previous-state transition; full source future-state Markov dependence cannot be replaced by memoryless independent hazard only
Original Bayesian joint posterior U(r,ξ|C1:t) and boundary initialized r=0 uniform previous state; covert likelihood/noise/lapse and overt optimal criterion distinct task output equations

Bayes_r assumes wrong run-length interval, Bayes_pi assumes wrong possible probability-state set, Bayes_beta assumes symmetric neutral-prior Beta hyperprior; original three variants alter different knowledge

Flexible Bayes_rπβ varies run-length interval, state range and beta-neutral hyperprior together with FIVE extra parameters, not included routine 11-model Fig3/Table1 standard fit and separately scored BIC/ELBO
source_claim_mapping.source_location: Main PDF p6 and S1 pp10–11

source_claim_mapping.source_native_proposition: Fixed criterion source sets neutral z=(μB+μA)/2 independent of learned category probability; not zero sensory likelihood in covert version
Exp initial category probability p_hat1=0.5 and delta update p_hat_t+1=α C_t+(1-α)p_hat_t, source direct one-step category feedback each trial
Expbias first updates source Exp p_hat then linear mixes with stable neutral 0.5, weight w. Two distinct described conceptual timescales, not observed neural compartments
Source Wilson 2013 approximate three-node variable integration with hazard-dependent weights l1=1 and l2,l3,nu_p fitted; original Wilson plus later correction is predecessor comparator
Main RL comparator updates decision criterion z only if response incorrect; unlike Exp, this model need not represent a probability state
Original appendix's separate RL_prob updates probability only after incorrect feedback, explicitly NOT source main Eq7 criterion-only RL; its fit no unique superiority

Original Behrens et al 2007 Bayesian comparator tracks probability pi, volatility v and volatility-change k via approximate five-dimensional grid and marginalization; unrelated to P13 new theorem provenance
Bayesian and probability-estimator models convert predicted category prior into decision criterion or covert posterior odds with separate visual-noise and adjustment-noise channels
source_claim_mapping.source_location: Main PDF p5/S1 p7 task model

source_claim_mapping.source_native_proposition: Both task observations show criterion or category response change following external prior shifts, no fixed criterion best fit; overt reports fluctuate between true changes
Multiple source computational model output shapes capture visible trends; figure shaded source 68% model-response intervals, not proof model semantic identity with brain
Original main 11-comparator model selection favors Expbias among that comparator set, source group protected exceedance φ=0.96 covert, 0.86 overt
Flexible five-additional-param Bayes_rπβ vs Expbias BIC and ELBO separately compared, neither task distinguishes statistically; do not report Bayesian ruled out
source_claim_mapping.source_location: Main PDF pp11–12 Fig3 and S1 FigS1

source_claim_mapping.source_native_proposition: Original group best model 6 of 11 in each task; source cross-task standardized LML score correlation r0.60, but individual best models can differ
Overt Expbias alpha0.22±0.03 w0.74±0.06 vs covert alpha0.17±0.04 w0.58±0.05; original w task difference significant and alpha not
source_claim_mapping.source_location: Main PDF p14 Fig5 / Tables1–2 p15

source_claim_mapping.source_native_proposition: Source average fitted category-history time constant approx4.5 trials vs true hazard expected run100, reflects fast perceived changes during longer real blocks, not environmental truth
source_claim_mapping.source_location: Main PDF p13–14 and p15 Discussion

source_claim_mapping.source_native_proposition: Simple Expbias considered more biologically plausible by authors but cannot distinguish flexible Bayes, actual algorithm/hierarchical state latent not measured by behavior alone
Source model recovery on 1980 simulated datasets per generative model/task, ~70% across tasks with RL mistaken for Exp in covert; not 100% identifiability
Original overt criterion adjustment-noise σ_a fitted upward bias in parameter recovery, source authors argue LML model comparisons not affected; distinguish estimates vs fit-score confidence
Original trial-specific category feedback externally reveals true C_t every trial; posterior over observed labels not latent unsupervised state inference about never-reported categories
Separate main covert and overt likelihood and lapse/noise differ; individual trial 800 per task after 200 training, cannot pool task-specific observation interfaces into identical response density
Original report model scoring favors source-specific neutral bias, not universal adaptive lifelong learning or direct neural demonstration that stable prior is literal physical storage
Original author published model/data code exists at lacerbi/ChangeProb; current G1 does not run original inference code or independently reproduce numeric curves
Source S1 Bayes_bias and Bayes_rβ extra competitors and RL_prob were also considered in appendix, not just nine main-text Eqs alone; source outcome constrains exclusions

bounded_fit_levels.qualification: Every source candidate's defined update and criterion already expressible using frozen Grammar v0, but data does NOT distinguish Expbias from much more flexible original Bayes. This is a model-atlas result, not one actual brain architecture proof.

No evidence for additional new stable meta-coordinator; source optional latent Bayes posterior is source-defined candidate and not biologically demonstrated.
